name: The Unwritten
description: You. People whose names burned with the Ledger.

name: Mire Hounds
description: Pack hunters of the mire. They eat ink-leeches and anything that bleeds.

name: The Ink-Rot
description: Living ink and the leeches that carry it.

name: The Hollowed
description: People and beasts whose names were unwritten. They remember only their last task.

name: Lanternfast
description: Forty souls sheltering under the Edict of the Hearth.

name: The Cinder Choir
description: Believers who sing the old laws and welcome the ink as the Ledger rewriting itself.
